Description: Manage authentication, patient access and doctor discovery.
As a Patient, I want to register and log into my account securely, so that I can access consultation history and book appointments.
Acceptance Criteria: User can register; user can log in; passwords are securely hashed; invalid login shows a clear error.

Description: As a Patient, I want to search and filter doctors by specialty and view their profiles, so that I can choose an appropriate provider.
Acceptance Criteria: Specialty filtering works; matching doctors appear; profiles show credentials/fees/availability; results meet the response-time target.

Description: Manage consultation slots, reservations and payment processing.
As a Patient, I want to select an available consultation slot and complete payment, so that my appointment is confirmed.
Acceptance Criteria: Available slots are shown; successful payment creates an Appointment ID; failed payment leaves the slot unreserved and permits retry.

Description: Manage secure video consultation room generation and delivery.
As a Patient/Physician, I want to receive a secure video consultation link, so that the consultation can occur remotely.
Acceptance Criteria: Unique time-bound link is generated after booking; patient and physician receive the link before the scheduled consultation.

Description: Manage digital prescription authoring, signing and secure records.
As a Physician, I want to author and digitally sign prescriptions, so that patients receive valid downloadable records.
Acceptance Criteria: Prescription can be authored; doctor license is verified; PDF is generated and digitally signed; patient can download the signed PDF.
